title: The Ballast Squatters
logline: An informal family of scavengers living in a decommissioned ballast tank must reinforce their makeshift bulkhead before automated high-pressure testing crushes their shelter.

roles.description: A retired pipefitter who built an informal family shelter inside a dead water ballast tank; stubborn, loving, and coughing.
A sharp-witted young scrapper who runs errands through the air ducts; fiercely protective of their home.
A municipal utility supervisor under pressure to complete hydrostatic integrity tests before quarter-end.
A hollow cavernous chamber inside the station's counterweight rim, strung with hammocks and illegal heating coils.
The municipal water intake station where industrial regulators and valves are stored.

public_situation: Municipal maintenance alerts on {system} warn that automated high-pressure testing of the outer ballast ring will commence at the end of the shift.
private_truth: An informal family of dispossessed scrap workers lives inside Ballast Tank Four; if the automated pressure surge fires, their makeshift living quarters will be crushed.

beats.public_change: Pumping sirens echo through the utility rings as engineers begin priming the water ballast circuits.

missions.reason: He needs an independent pilot to mine raw ferrite ore from the ring belts to patch an illegal structural seal before water pressure floods the chamber.
missions.private_fact: He cannot buy plates from the market without triggering an automated dock inspection of his expired transit visa.

beats.public_change: The municipal plumbing supervisor begins calibrating acoustic leak sensors across the ballast quadrant.

missions.reason: They hire the pilot to buy an industrial bypass valve from the intake depot to divert the incoming test water around Tank Four.
missions.private_fact: They are paying with stolen utility tokens swiped from the plumbing supervisor's maintenance locker.

beats.public_change: The final test sequence begins filling the outer ring manifold while municipal inspectors check sensor logs.

missions.reason: He hires an outsider pilot to scan the exterior hull of Tank Four to verify why pressure readings are displaying anomalous thermal signatures.
missions.private_fact: He suspects squatters are inside, but his performance bonus depends on certifying the system as clear on time.

player_choice.prompt: With the scan complete and the pressure test roaring in the pipes, the pilot holds the fate of the family in their hands.

options.label: Certify the tank as empty so the plumber ignores the readings
Confront the plumber and negotiate an emergency evacuation before the surge
Report the illegal habitat to port bailiffs to stop the water test

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot certifies the hull as clear, allowing the bypass valve to divert the surge water.
resolutions.summary: The test water rushes harmlessly through the bypass. {role:elder_squatter} and {role:adopted_foundling} keep their hidden home safe in the ballast voids.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a hidden family in the station ballast tanks bypass a catastrophic high-pressure flood.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot confronts the plumber and arranges a discreet evacuation.
resolutions.summary: {role:station_plumber} halts the test and quietly moves {role:elder_squatter} and the child into a vacant service dormitory before the surge fires.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a plumbing supervisor safely relocate squatters before an automated water test.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot reports the squatters to port security.
resolutions.summary: Port bailiffs breach the tank and evict {role:elder_squatter} into station detention. The pressure test completes on schedule without incident.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot reported an unauthorized habitat in a water tank, triggering a security sweep.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never gets involved or abandons the scan.
resolutions.summary: The automated pressure test fires at full power. The makeshift bulkhead collapses and the ballast chamber floods, forcing the squatters to flee into cold maintenance vents.

loose_threads.detail: The bypass valve package is tied to an internal utility work requisition that was signed by a maintenance supervisor who died two years ago.
The official plumbing schedule indicates water pressure testing was moved forward two weeks at the request of an offshore habitat developer.

radio_hooks: Automated hydrostatic testing scheduled for outer ballast ring of {system}; pressure surges expected.
Utility management warns unauthorized access to decommissioned ballast compartments is punishable by fine.
Outer ring water pressure restored following successful municipal pipe diagnostics.

voice_direction.elder_squatter: Weary, warm, and speaks in short, breathless bursts. Pauses frequently and insists on offering the pilot recycled station tea. Fiercely defensive of his child.
voice_direction.adopted_foundling: Speaks at a rapid, defensive clip with fierce pride. Refuses to look at credentials and sizes up the pilot's ship with practical eye.
voice_direction.station_plumber: Anxious, sweaty, and overly defensive. Constantly consults his tablet computer and complains about departmental quotas.
